findings.detail: The notebook still uses tqdm for its progress loop. design.md Technology Stack says tqdm was dropped in favor of a simple counter. This is a design-discretion detail, not an acceptance criterion or locked fix, so it does not block.
findings.fix: Optionally replace the tqdm loop with a plain enumerate/counter and drop tqdm from any dev dependency to match the stated stack.

summary: All six LOCKED FIXES are honored and every acceptance criterion is satisfied. Verified live: cdk synth succeeds with Docker NOT running (Locked Fix 1 — the provider Lambda carries a pre-populated s3vectors-capable boto3 layer asset with no BundlingOptions/pip-at-synth); the synthesized template contains both S3 buckets, the S3 Vectors custom resource, the data-plane ManagedPolicy, and all five CfnOutputs (BucketName/VectorBucketName/VectorIndexName/VectorBucketArn/DataPlanePolicyArn) with ZERO Bedrock Agent/AgentAlias/exec-role/action-group-Lambda and ZERO OpenSearch resources. pytest is green (35 passed) with boto3/HTTP mocked. The grep gate is clean in active source (bedrock-agent-runtime/opensearch/aoss/AWSV4SignerAuth/titan/generated_s3_uri/CfnAgent/AmazonBedrockExecutionRoleForAgents all absent; the only profile_name hit is a notebook comment asserting NFR-1 compliance, and the alexhrn profile is gone). Two-region split is correct (primary=us-east-1 brain via us. profile + inpaint/outpaint us. profiles + s3/s3vectors; embedding_region=us-east-1 Nova 2 ON_DEMAND; image_region=us-west-2 stable-image bare id) with fail-fast region validation. IAM ARN fan-out is correct: each us.-prefixed id emits inference-profile + backing foundation-model ARNs across all three fan-out regions {us-east-1,us-east-2,us-west-2}, bare ids emit a single region-neutral foundation-model ARN (21 ARNs total), and tests/test_iam_arns.py asserts the per-region fan-out. No lazy bootstrap_index exists (Locked Fix 2 — build_agent calls GetIndex and raises a fatal ConfigError on NotFound; the notebook is the sole index creator/populator; the provider is not granted CreateIndex). aspect_ratio and seed are omitted from the Stability text-to-image body (Locked Fix 4). The Strands status slot is success|error only, with a recoverable weather/lookup miss returned as status=success + nested result=not_found via the native ToolResult envelope (Locked Fix 6). expected_dimension defaults to null, the embeddingDimension request hint is sent only when non-null, the notebook measures the dimension via len(probe_vector), and no 1024 is hardcoded as an embedding dimension (Locked Fix 3). The single NIT (tqdm in the notebook) is non-blocking.
